title: Federated Vector Retrieval across Heterogeneous VectorDBs
topic: 异构向量空间与联合检索
code_status: 作者源码可见，但未声明许可证；本地按论文公式独立实现，未复制作者源码。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.hvmap import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Approximately 2.5M paired embeddings, 40 epochs, batch 1792, multiple datasets/encoders and large vector indexes.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Full training and index/throughput matrix exceed the fixed 180-second single-device component budget.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅对小张量执行映射前后向、fuzzy contrastive loss、SCORE2及hub/spoke路径，不下载全数据、不尝试完整训练。

summary: 用配对向量训练跨编码空间映射，独立取每库K候选，再以native/mapped双空间SCORE2联合重排。局部实现四层映射、绝对锚定的fuzzy loss和星形路径；小张量不代表检索能力，完整索引/训练矩阵高成本不复现。
